title: Project registry entry <registry_dir>/<name>.yaml
description: bin/registry.py is the full validation (file system checks: run resolves, directories exist, after points to existing jobs); this is the shape for other programs to read.

models.description: model calls this project makes through the platform (agenthub complete): point name -> its tier; the platform picks the model

agents.description: confined agent calls this project's code makes through the platform (brunna agent <name>): name -> its tier, its allow: rules (the whole boundary) and an optional timeout (default 30m); docs/design/project-agent-calls.md A

agents_per_day.description: the most minutes of agent calls this project runs a day; lowers the platform's per-project share (cap_runner.agent_minutes_per_project), never raises it

metered_models.description: the owner allows metered (pay-per-use) providers for those calls; a security field only the platform sets

layout_intent.description: what the owner said about this project's layout when connecting it, for when projects-and-repos lands: split (a monorepo into its parts) or span (several repos as one project); docs/design/newcomer-path.md B6

commits.description: commit titles follow Conventional Commits, checked by the merge gate; absent = not checked

wake.description: false: a letter never wakes or is routed to this project's sessions (docs/design/mailbox-session-first.md). Owner-only: manifest.update can't change it. Default on

tier.description: fast | standard | strong, agent jobs with allow: only: the model strength its run uses instead of the tool's default (an owner's pin on the judgment point still wins); only where the runtime can tell how the run is paid for, a pay-per-use one needing metered_models

mail.description: a scheduled agent job with allow: only, never an event job: its run gets the platform's mail tools to start new letters (send, ask the owner, notes when its rules write them); never to read, reply or close

trigger.description: event-triggered job (docs/design/event-jobs.md): exactly one of at, every, trigger

events.description: bus event types (the hubbus contract's type enum)

projects.description: self (default), a project name or *; other projects only for the platform project and modules

sources.description: globs the event source must match

where.description: payload key (dots for nesting) -> value or list of values; strings with * ? [ are globs

secrets.description: the credentials this project uses: only names, locations, expiry, no values

capabilities.description: platform capabilities (hub.json capabilities, e.g. gpu); inside the sandbox, hub-run --cap <capability> runs through the platform runner

work.description: a discuss session (lease) may write to the project; requires sandbox: true (the OS sandbox blocks writes outside the folder). Turned on only when the owner confirms directly
